dct_title_s: Geographic map of the Zorzor quadrangle, Liberia
dct_description_sm: prepared by the U.S. Geological Survey and the Liberian Geological Survey under the joint sponsorship of the government of Liberia and the Agency for International Development, U.S. Department of State.
Relief shown by shadings and spot heights.
